title: In The Public Eye
summary:
In The Public Eye
As the stock markets in the United States continue on their bull run, tanker equities are no exception. With substantial gains in 2007 to date, listed tanker companies seem to be getting the public recognition for which they have been striving. The chart below shows the Poten Tanker Index, an indicator of the freight markets, and the Poten Equity Index, compiled of tanker stocks.

children.title: Ups and Downs
children.summary: One sector in particular that has been of interest to several public companies has been the product carrier segment. In the past year there has been considerable ordering activity of coated vessels and sale and purchase of existing ships.

children.title: UKC - USAC TCE
children.summary: Trendline Investors and market consensus has traditionally reacted to short- term rates. It is more difficult to rationalize an investment of $48 million dollars per product carrier, when day rates are under $10,000 per day.

children.title: Asset Values
children.summary: Companies continue to acquire vessels although asset prices remain very high by historical standards. Asset plays have proven to be quite lucrative for vessel owners, particularly resales of shipbuilding contracts with forward delivery.
